n-k-k8-02.title: Ngamazwi obani lawa?
n-k-k8-02.topic: izindaba: ukuqanjwa kwemithombo nokuthi ubani oma ngemuva kwesimangalo
n-k-k8-02.goal: Hlukanisa lokho isihloko sezindaba esikubika njengesimangalo noma isibikezelo sikabani nalokho esikubala njengedatha, bese ubona isifinyezo esiguqula isimangalo sibe yiqiniso.
n-k-k8-02.material:
Funda lesi sihloko esifushane (esiqanjiwe).

□□시, 막차 1시간 늦춘다

□□시는 다음 달부터 시내버스 막차 시간을 1시간 늦춘다고 밝혔다. 시 관계자는 "이용객이 늘어난 노선부터 차례로 넓혀 갈 계획"이라고 설명했다. 지난해 밤 10시 이후 버스 이용객은 전년보다 12% 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 한 시민단체는 막차가 늦어지면 귀갓길 사고가 줄어들 것이라고 주장했다. 버스 노조는 운전기사가 부족해 계획대로 시행하기 어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장을 내놓았다.
n-k-k8-02.prereq.1: Wazi izenzo zokubika ezinjenge-밝혔다, 주장했다, 설명했다
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ZONKE izitatimende isihloko sizidlulisela kuphela njengombono noma isibikezelo somunye ongaphandle, ngaphandle kokusho ukuthi liyiqiniso.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ngesitatimende ngasinye buza: ubani okhulumayo, futhi sekwenziwe kakade, noma kulindeleke kuphela?
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka izenzo eziphetha imisho: ezinye zithi 'announced' noma 'counted', ezinye zithi 'argued' noma 'position'.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu idolobha lemezela isinqumo salo mayelana namabhasi alo; umbiko ubika lokho idolobha elikushilo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kubikwa njengenani elibaliwe, hhayi njengomqondo womuntu noma isibikezelo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.e: Lolu uhlelo lwedolobha uqobo, olushiwo yisikhulu salo; akusona isibikezelo somuntu wangaphandle.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.explain: Bobabili u-b no-c ziyizibikezelo ezibekwe eqenjini ('주장했다', '어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장'). Umbiko ubika ukuthi bakusho; awusho ukuthi kuzokwenzeka ngempela. U-a no-e ngunqumo nohlelo lwedolobha, futhi u-d uyinani elibaliwe.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi naye ufinyeza indatshana ngemigqa emihlanu. Imigqa emibili iguqula isimangalo noma isibikezelo somuntu sibe yiqiniso nje. Khetha owodwa wayo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hlala ngaphansi komkhulumi womusho ngamunye wendatshana, bese uhlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye wesifinyezo uyamgcina.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.1: Funa imigqa lapho isibikezelo sesibe yitatimende lalokho okwenzekile noma okuqinisekile.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.explain: Imigqa 3 no-5 ayilungile. Endatshaneni iqembu lomphakathi liphikisa ukuthi izingozi zizokwehla, futhi inyunyana ilindele ubunzima kuphela. Imigqa 3 no-5 ishiya abakhulumi futhi ibeka lokhu njengamaqiniso. Imigqa 1, 2 no-4 igcina umkhulumi.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.prompt: Omunye umfundi ubhala: '막차를 늦추면 사고가 줄어든다.' NgesiNgisi noma ngesiKorea, chaza ukuthi kuphutha ini kulo musho, usebenzisa amazwi endatshana uqobo.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.0: Thola endatshaneni ukuthi ubani owathi izingozi zizokwehla ngempela.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sho ukuthi luhlobo luni lwesitatimende lokhu (isinqumo, ukubala, noma okunye) nokuthi umusho womfundi naye wakwenzani.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngisho ukuthi ubani owenze isimangalo?
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngisho ukuthi ukubikezela noma isimangalo, hhayi okuqinisekiswa yindatshana?
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.model.0: Indatshana isho kuphela ukuthi iqembu lomphakathi liphikisa (주장했다) ukuthi izingozi zizokwehla. Isibikezelo sabo, hhayi umphumela oqinisekisiwe, ngakho umusho usho njengeqiniso.

n-k-k8-05.title: Ihora lesishiyagalolunye nehora nengxenye engu-2 nengxenye
n-k-k8-05.topic: izisho zesikhathi: 정각, 반, 정오, 자정; ukungavumelani ngaphakathi kohlelo
n-k-k8-05.goal: Thola imigqa emibili yohlelo lwe-retreat engenakuba yiqiniso yomibili, uyilungise, bese uhlulela ukuthi isaziso ngokwaso sibonisa ukuthi muphi umugqa owawuyiphutha.
n-k-k8-05.material:
Isikole sithumela lolu hlelo lwe-retreat yokulala kubazali. Lufunde lonke.

수련회 일정 안내 (6월 14일)
※ 정각 = ngqo ehoreni, 정오 = emini, 자정 = phakathi kwamabili.
n-k-k8-05.prereq.0: Ungafunda izikhathi zewashi ezifana no-11시 30분 no-두 시간 반
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.prompt: Imigqa emibili yohlelo ayikwazi ukuba yiqiniso yomibili. Khetha noma yimuphi owodwa wayo.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola umugqa ngamunye onikeza isikhathi sokuqala nobude ngokumelene nesikhathi othi siphela ngaso.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.1: Nakisisa imigqa encike emgqeni ongaphambi kwayo.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 1 no-2 iyaphikisana: ukuhamba ngo-9:00 ngohambo lwamahora ayi-2 nengxenye kusho ukufika ngo-11:30, hhayi ngo-11:00. Imigqa 3 kuya ku-6 iyahambisana (12:00 + ihora eli-1; 1:00 + amahora angu-3 = 4:00; 6:00 + amahora angu-1.5 = 7:30).
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha UMUGQA OWODWA wemigqa emibili ephikisanayo ngesiKorea (noma ubhale isikhathi esilungisiwe ngesiNgisi) ukuze imigqa emibili ivumelane.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.0: Engeza ubude bohambo esikhathini sokuhamba bese ubhala umphumela.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ungashintsha isikhathi sokufika, ubude bohambo noma isikhathi sokuhamba, kodwa zontathu kumele zivumelane.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe isikhathi sokuhamba, ubude bohambo nesikhathi sokufika manje zengeza kahle?
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kulungisa ubude bohambo esikhundleni sesikhathi sokufika.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.model.2: Ukufika ngo-11:30 (ngesigamu sehora ngemva kweshumi nanye)
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.prompt: Umfundi naye uthi: 'Obviously the arrival time is the typo.' Ingabe kuphephile ukuphetha lokho ngohlelo kuphela?
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala izinombolo ezintathu okumele zihambisane bese ubuza ukuthi iyiphi umbhalo ofakazela ukuthi ayilungile.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.1: Buza ukuthi ulwazi olungeziwe luyokwenza uqiniseke yini.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.a: Yebo: isikhathi sokufika siza ekugcineni kochungechunge, ngakho yiyona ethayiphwe ngephutha.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.a: Ukulandelana kwemigqa akubonisi ukuthi iyiphi inombolo engalungile; inombolo yangaphambili ingaba yiphutha ngokulula.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.b: Yebo: abazali bazohlola isikhathi sokufika, ngakho isikole kumele sibe nephutha.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.b: Lokho abazali bakuhlolayo akubonisi ukuthi iyiphi inombolo engalungile.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.c: Cha: imigqa emibili isivele ivumelana, ngakho akukho okudinga ukulungiswa.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.c: U-9:00 kanye namahora angu-2 nemizuzu engu-30 kungu-11:30, okungavumelani no-11:00.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.d: Cha: noma yiyiphi yezinombolo ezintathu ingaba yiphutha, ngakho isikole kumele siqinisekise.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.explain: Umbhalo ubonisa kuphela ukuthi izinombolo ezintathu (ukuhamba, ubude bohambo, ukufika) azihambisani. Noma yiyiphi ingalunganga, ngakho isikole kumele sisho ukuthi iyiphi eqinile. Ukulungisa owubhalile kuyiqagelo elinengqondo, hhayi ubufakazi.

n-k-k8-01.title: Ubani ongena ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yesaziso?
n-k-k8-01.goal: Funda amagama ezinombolo esazisweni esisemthethweni sokuvolontiya, wakhe ukubhalisa okuningana okwanelisa yonke imikhawulo, bese uchaza ngamagama akho ukuthi kungani umuntu oseduze komngcele engena noma engekho.
n-k-k8-01.material:
Idolobha lamisa lesi saziso. 만 N세 isho 'iminyaka ye-N ngokubala komthetho waseKorea'. Phatha zonke izinombolo njengamanani agcwele.

청소년 봉사단 '이웃' 참가자 모집 안내
1. 대상: 만 13세 이상, 만 18세 미만 청소년
2. 팀 구성: 한 팀은 3명 이상 5명 이하
3. 하루 활동 시간: 최소 1시간 이상, 4시간을 초과할 수 없음
4. 활동 일수: 5일 미만
5. 인증서: 총 활동 시간(하루 활동 시간 × 활동 일수)이 10시간 이상이어야 받을 수 있음
n-k-k8-01.thinking.0: Ukufunda amagama omngcele: umkhawulo uhlanganisa inombolo ngokwayo?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.prompt: Isigaba 3 sithi '4시간을 초과할 수 없음'. Umhlanganyeli angasebenza ngempela amahora angu-4 ngosuku olulodwa?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sho isigaba ngokuzwakalayo ngamagama akho: yini enqatshelwe, amahora angu-4 noma okunye?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bona umuntu osebenza amahora angu-4 ncamashi bese ubuza ukuthi isigaba siyaphulwa yini.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.a: Cha: 초과 ihlanganisa inombolo ngokwayo, ngakho amahora angu-4 ncamashi anqatshelwe.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.a: 초과 isho 'ngaphezu kwa-' futhi ayihlanganisi inombolo. Iqhathanise ne-이상, ehlanganisa yona.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.b: Yebo: ukuvinjelwa kungamahora aphelele, hhayi amahora osuku olulodwa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.b: Isigaba sithi simayelana ne-하루 (usuku olulodwa); isamba silinganiswa ngokwehlukile esigabeni 5.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.c: Yebo, kodwa kuphela iqembu elinamalungu amahlanu.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.c: Akukho okusesigabeni 3 okuncike osayizini weqembu; iqembu ngesinye isigaba.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.d: Yebo: amahora angu-4 ngumkhawulo uqobo; ngaphezu kwe-4 kuphela okunqatshelwe.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.explain: 초과 isho 'ngaphezu kwa-' futhi iyayishiya inombolo, ngakho amahora angu-4 avunyelwe futhi amahora angu-5 awavunyelwe. 이상/이하 zihlanganisa inombolo; 초과/미만 azikwenzi.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.prompt: Gcwalisa ukubhalisa OKUNYE okungenzeka isaziso esikuvumelayo futhi esitholela isitifiketi. Yenza ukubhalisa okuhlukile okungu-3 kwezigaba ezingu-3 ezihlukile. a = iminyaka (만 나이), n = usayizi weqembu, h = amahora ngosuku, d = inani lezinsuku.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.0: Guqula isigaba ngasinye esinenombolo sibe umthetho omfushane ngenombolo eyodwa ngaphambi kokukhetha amanani.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ngeminyaka, bese ukhetha amahora nezinsuku ndawonye, ngoba isigaba 5 siyazixhumanisa.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola inani eduze nomngcele ngamunye (inombolo encane kakhulu nenkulu kakhulu isigaba ngasinye esibonakala sivumela) bese ufunda imilayezo evelayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Isigaba 3: okungenani ihora elingu-1 futhi kungabi ngaphezu kwamahora angu-4 ngosuku.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c5: Isigaba 5: amahora ngosuku x izinsuku kumele kube ngu-10 noma ngaphezulu.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.explain: Imingcele: iminyaka engu-13 ingaphakathi futhi engu-18 ingaphandle; amaqembu angu-3 nangu-5 kokubili angaphakathi; amahora angu-4 ngosuku angaphakathi; izinsuku ezingu-5 zingaphandle; isamba samahora angu-10 ncamashi sanele. Ukubhalisa okuningi kuyafaneleka ngoba isaziso sinikeza imikhawulo, hhayi uhlelo olulodwa ncamashi.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Umngani unemiyaka engu-만 18세 namuhla ncamashi futhi ufuna ukujoyina. Ngomusho owodwa noma emibili (isiKorea noma isiNgisi), tshela umngani ukuthi angajoyina yini nokuthi kungani, usebenzisa amagama esaziso.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kuqala nquma isinqumo se-18 ncamashi, bese uqamba igama lesigaba elinquma.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi 이상 ne-미만 kuyiphatha kanjani inombolo ebhalwe eceleni kwazo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngishilo ngokucacile ukuthi u-18 uqobo awuvumelekile?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngisebenzise igama 미만 noma ngachaza lokho elishiya ngaphandle?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Akakwazi ukujoyina. Isaziso sithi ngaphansi kwe-18 (미만), futhi 미만 ayihlanganisi u-18 uqobo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.prompt: Ilungu labasebenzi liphendula imibuzo ngesaziso esifanayo. Imigqa emibili iyaphutha ngomngcele wemikhawulo. Khetha owodwa wayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ngomugqa ngamunye, thola isigaba esihambisanayo negama lomngcele elisebenzisayo.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.1: Buza ngomugqa ngamunye: leli gama lomngcele libala inombolo ebhalwe eceleni kwalo?
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.explain: Imigqa 2 no-5 ayilungile. '5명 이하' ihlanganisa u-5, ngakho iqembu labahlanu livunyelwe. '10시간 이상' ihlanganisa u-10, ngakho amahora angu-10 ncamashi atholela isitifiketi. Imigqa 1, 3 no-4 ifunda imingcele ngokulungile.

n-k-k8-03.title: Ukuhlola inothi lolimi lomfundi naye
n-k-k8-03.goal: Hlola umthetho wolimi womfundi naye ngezibonelo, nquma ukuthi uwulungise kanjani, bese ubhala umusho wakho oyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-k-k8-03.material:
Umfundi naye wabhala lokhu encwadini.

  규칙: -(으)ㄴ/는데 = 'but'. 앞의 내용과 뒤의 내용이 서로 반대일 때 쓴다.

Umfundi naye uyakubuza: 'Ingabe umthetho wami uhlala ulungile?' Wuhlole.
n-k-k8-03.prereq.1: Ungabhala umusho olula wesiKorea esikhathini esedlule noma samanje
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.prompt: Yimuphi umusho osibonelo esiphikisayo, lapho u--(으)ㄴ/는데 elungile kodwa izingxenye ezimbili AZIPHIKISANI?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umusho ngamunye bese uzama ukubeka u-'but' phakathi kwezingxenye zawo ezimbili: ingabe uzwakala wemvelo kuzo zonke izimo?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi ingxenye yesibili iyamangalisa noma iphambene neyokuqala, noma iyingxenye elandelayo yendaba nje.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.a: Lapha ingxenye yesibili iphikisana nalokho u-'pretty' okwenza ukulindele, ngakho ihambisana nomthetho futhi akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.b: Ingxenye yesibili iyamangalisa uma kunikezwe eyokuqala, ngakho ihambisana nomthetho.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.d: Umphumela uphikisana nomzamo, ngakho uhambisana nomthetho.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.explain: Ku-c ingxenye yokuqala inikeza isimo kuphela (ngiye e-mart) futhi ingxenye yesibili isho engikutholile. Akukho okuphikisanayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nquma ukuthi uwulahle umthetho noma ushintshe ukuthi usho kangakanani.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ukulungisa kwakho kusachaza imisho yokuphikisana nesibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.a: Gcina umthetho njengoba unjalo, ngoba iningi lemisho ye--는데 liphikisana.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.a: Umthetho othi 'njalo' uphulwa isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo esicacile, noma ingaki eminye imisho ehambisana nawo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.b: Sho ukuthi u--는데 uvame ukuphikisa kodwa angabeka futhi isimo sezinto ezilandelayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.c: Sho ukuthi u--는데 uvame ukubeka isimo, futhi izibonelo zokuphikisana ziyizihlibhi.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.c: Imisho yokuphikisana iyiSiKorea esijwayelekile; umthetho muncane kakhulu, kodwa awuphutha ngokuphelele.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.d: Sho ukuthi u--는데 uphikisana ekubhaleni, kodwa ekukhulumeni awuphikisani.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.d: Akukho emibonelweni encike ekukhulumeni ngokumelene nokubhala.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.explain: Umthetho othi 'ukuphikisana kuphela' uphulwa isibonelo esisodwa esihle esiphikisayo. Ukulungisa kugcina okuyiqiniso (ukuphikisana kungukusetshenziswa okukodwa) futhi kwengeza ukusetshenziswa okushodayo (ukubeka isimo sengxenye elandelayo).
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umusho wakho wesiKorea no--(으)ㄴ/는데 lapho izingxenye ezimbili AZIPHIKISANI. Bese wengeza inothi elifushane (isiNgisi noma isiKorea) elisho ukuthi ingxenye yokuqala yenzani kweyesibili.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ngesikhathi lapho ubeka isimo ngaphambi kokubuza noma ukutshela okuthile: kuphi, nini, ubone ini.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ngemva kokubhala, zama ukubeka u-'but' phakathi kwezingxenye zakho ezimbili; uma kuzwakala kubi, unesibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe u-'but' wayezoba yiphutha phakathi kwezingxenye ezimbili zomusho wami?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe inothi lami lisho ukuthi ingxenye yokuqala yenzani (isibonelo inikeza isimo noma isizathu sokubuza)?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.model.0: 내일 시간이 있는데 같이 영화 볼래요? (Ingxenye yokuqala inikeza isimo, bese ngimema.)

n-k-k8-04.title: Umthetho wokubuyiselwa kwemali oqhubeka nokushintsha
n-k-k8-04.topic: imigomo nezimo: umthetho, okuhlukile, okuhlukile kokuhlukile
n-k-k8-04.goal: Buyekeza isinqumo sokubuyiselwa kwemali njengoba izigaba eziningi zemigomo yethikithi zivela, sebenzisa izigaba kumthengi wesibili, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani impendulo ishintshile.
n-k-k8-04.material: U-Mina uthenge ithikithi le-concert ezinsukwini ezi-5 ezedlule. I-concert iseyizinsuku eziyi-10 kusukela namuhla. Akakwazi ukuya, ngakho namuhla ufaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwemali. Imigomo yethikithi ivela isigaba esisodwa ngesikhathi.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda isigaba ngasinye ngokulandelana bese ukhetha impendulo engcono kakhulu ku-'Ngabe u-Mina angathola kangakanani ekubuyiselweni kwemali?' usebenzisa kuphela izigaba ezibonisiwe kuze kube manje.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sebenzisa kuphela izigaba ongazibona; ungaqageli ukuthi kuzokwenzenzani.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.1: Isikhathi ngasinye, hlola izinsuku zika-Mina (izinsuku ezi-5 kusukela ekuthengeni, izinsuku eziyi-10 kuze kube i-concert) ngokumelene nesigaba ngasinye esibonisiwe.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Isigaba sibeka umthetho ngaphandle kokuhlukile kuze kube manje. U-'Akukho kubuyiselwa' yimpendulo enengqondo, nakuba umfundi onakekelayo ekhumbula ukuthi okuhlukile kungalandela.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Akukho emshweni lesi sigaba esinikeza imali ibuyele.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lesi sigaba asisho lutho ngenkokhelo noma ukubuyiselwa kwemali.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngalesi sigaba esingeziwe, u-Mina angathola kangakanani ekubuyiselweni kwemali?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.after: U-Mina ufaka isicelo ezinsukwini eziyi-10 ngaphambi kwe-concert, okuyisikhathi esandulela u-'7일 전', ngakho isigaba ② sibonakala sinikeza ukubuyiselwa kwemali kukhishwe inkokhelo. Kodwa isigaba esisha singase sisakukhawulela.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Isigaba ② siyisinye ('다만') ku-①, futhi u-Mina ufaka isicelo ezinsukwini eziyi-10 ngaphambi kwe-concert, ngakho u-② ubonakala usebenza.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Inkokhelo ye-10% iyakhishwa, ngakho akuyona imali ebuyiselwa ephelele.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngazo zonke izigaba ezintathu, u-Mina angathola kangakanani ekubuyiselweni kwemali?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Isigaba ③ sengeza umbandela wesibili ku-②: isicelo kumele sifike ezinsukwini ezi-3 kusukela ekuthengeni. U-Mina uthenge ezinsukwini ezi-5 ezedlule, ngakho u-② awusebenzi futhi isigaba ① sinquma: akukho kubuyiselwa.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uthenge ezinsukwini ezi-5 ezedlule, okungaphezu kwezinsuku ezi-3, ngakho u-② awusasebenzi kuye.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Akukho sigaba esinikeza ukubuyiselwa okuphelele ecaleni lakhe.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lezi zigaba ezintathu seziyaqeda izinsuku zika-Mina; ungasho 'kuncike eminye imigomo', kodwa isinqumo sisekelwe kulokho onakho.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.reflect: Umthetho wokuqala wanikeza 'cha', okuhlukile kwawuguqula waba ngu-'yebo, kukhishwe inkokhelo', futhi isigaba sokugcina sakhawulela lokho okuhlukile futhi. Amagama u-다만 no-제2항은 ... 경우에만 aphawula lezo zinyathelo. Funda zonke izigaba ngaphambi kokunquma.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.prompt: Manje sebenzisa izigaba ezintathu ezifanayo ku-Jun. U-Jun uthenge ithikithi izolo. I-concert iseyizinsuku ezi-4 kusukela namuhla. Ufaka isicelo namuhla. Angathola kangakanani ekubuyiselweni kwemali?
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola u-Jun ngombandela ngamunye ngesikhathi: usuku lokuthenga nezinsuku ezisele ngaphambi kwe-concert.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.1: Isigaba esinikeza okuhlukile sisebenza kuphela lapho yonke imibandela yaso ihlangatshezwa.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.a: Ukubuyiselwa kukhishwe inkokhelo ye-10%, ngoba wafaka isicelo ezinsukwini ezi-3.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.a: Isigaba ② sinomunye umbandela: isicelo kumele sifike okungenani izinsuku eziyi-7 ngaphambi kwe-concert.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.b: Akukho kubuyiselwa, ngoba usuku lokugcina lwezinsuku eziyi-7 lwe-② seludlulile.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.c: Ukubuyiselwa okuphelele, ngoba uthenge ithikithi izolo kuphela.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.c: Akukho emshweni izigaba ezinikeza ukubuyiselwa okuphelele ekuthengeni kwakamuva.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.d: Akukho kubuyiselwa, ngoba u-② wamathikithi athengwe ezinsukwini ezi-3 noma ngaphezulu ezedlule kuphela.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.d: Isigaba ③ sithi okuphambene: u-② usebenza kuphela ezinsukwini ezi-3 kusukela ekuthengeni.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.explain: U-Jun uhlangabezana nombandela wezinsuku ezi-3 ka-③, kodwa isigaba ② sidinga futhi isicelo izinsuku eziyi-7 ngaphambi kwe-concert, futhi zisele ezi-4 kuphela. Ngakho u-② awusebenzi, futhi u-① uthi akukho kubuyiselwa.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.prompt: U-Mina uyabuza: 'Isigaba ② sithi ngithola ukubuyiselwa, ngakho kungani impendulo yami ishintshile?' NgesiNgisi noma ngesiKorea, chaza ngemisho emibili noma emithathu.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.hint.0: Thola isigaba esengezwe ekugcineni bese usho ukuthi siletha muphi umbandela owengeziwe.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa lowo mbandela nenani lezinsuku kusukela u-Mina athenge ithikithi.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngiqambe umbandela wezinsuku ezi-3 wesigaba ③?
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngisho ukuthi kungani usuku lokuthenga luka-Mina alihlangabezani nawo?
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.model.0: Isigaba ③ sithi isigaba ② sisebenza kuphela uma ufaka isicelo ezinsukwini ezi-3 kusukela ekuthengeni. U-Mina uthenge ezinsukwini ezi-5 ezedlule, ngakho u-② awusebenzi kuye futhi umthetho oyisisekelo ① (akukho kubuyiselwa) uyabamba.
